title: Progress in Construction of North-South Expressway
what_it_is: Progress in Construction of North-South Expressway

sections.label: North-South Corridor civil contracts
sections.summary: LTA has launched tenders for eight of 16 major civil contracts for the North-South Corridor, with construction expected to start early next year and complete in 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA has launched tenders for eight out of the 16 major civil contracts for the North-South Corridor.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Construction works are expected to commence early next year and complete in 2026.

sections.label: North-South Corridor project details
sections.summary: The North-South Expressway, announced in January 2008, became the North-South Corridor linking Sembawang, Woodlands and Yishun to the city, with cycling and pedestrian paths.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Yes, the North-South Expressway project was announced in January 2008 by LTA, but along the way, I think there was a change in plan because we wanted to convert this into a North-South Corridor, rather than just an expressway, that will link the towns in the north which include Sembawang, Woodlands and Yishun to the city.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: And this will, hopefully, help reduce bus journey time by up to 30 minutes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As this will be our first integrated transport corridor in Singapore, in addition to just vehicular access, there will also be cycling and pedestrian pathways throughout the surface of the 21.5-kilometre expressway, and the vehicles will ply mainly underground on a highway which will have one of the three lanes in each direction dedicated for bus services.

sections.label: CTE widening and ERP measures
sections.summary: LTA completed CTE widening between Ang Mo Kio Avenues 1 and 3, and earlier projects, deployed nine ERP gantries, and expects traffic to improve when the Thomson-East Coast Line opens.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: LTA has completed the widening of the CTE between Ang Mo Kio Avenue 1 and Ang Mo Kio Avenue 3, from the dual three lanes to four lanes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In 2011, LTA also completed widening projects of the CTE between Bukit Timah Road and Yio Chu Kang Road.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: And, of course, with the deployment of ERP, LTA has implemented nine ERP gantries along CTE and slip roads leading to the CTE.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Last but not least, the Thomson-East Coast Line, as the Member is aware, is undergoing construction and traffic conditions are expected to improve after the opening of the Thomson-East Coast Line in stages from 2019 to 2021, as commuters would be able to take the MRT to Shenton Way and Marina Bay.
